_comment: DISPLAY COPY ONLY — the words and the suggested numbers /support/ draws.
Nothing here can charge anyone. The authoritative prices live in
hub-public-functions/support-catalog.mjs and the Stripe account; the page
sends KEYS to /api/checkout and the server resolves what they cost.
An `amount` below that disagrees with its Stripe Price is a display bug —
a wrong label on a right charge — not a pricing hole.
Campaign, tier and referrer keys must match support-catalog.mjs.
Run `node ops/check-support-catalog.mjs` after editing either file.
_benefits_comment: The SAME at every price, which is why the page shows this list once above
the prices instead of a blurb per tier. A higher amount buys more support
of the work, not more stuff. Mirrors BENEFITS in support-catalog.mjs —
see the long note there for why adding a fourth line fails two tests at
once (fulfilment burden, and charitable deductibility if a campaign ever
benefits: Your name on the supporters page, if you want it there.
Your mail gets read and answered by a person.
The occasional note from the workbench when something lands — no schedule, no newsletter.
_tiers_comment: Two displayed prices per interval, not four. People reliably pick the
second-lowest of whatever is shown, so the lower rung mostly exists to make
the suggested one second-lowest. Anyone wanting to give more uses the open
amount, which has no ceiling — a fixed top tier would cap the most generous
supporter at its price. Yearly is ten months' money for twelve.
The tier key IS the amount: no Friend/Patron ladder. Among a dozen
supporters who mostly know each other, a status ladder makes somebody
publicly the cheap one and buys nothing, since the benefits are identical.

monthly.note: Keeps a domain and its hosting up for a month.
Hosting and model credits, and the time to write the work up properly instead of leaving it in a repo.

yearly.note: Ten months' money for twelve. A domain and its hosting for the year.
Ten months' money for twelve. The working rate — most of what gets made is made on this.

_referrers_comment: Mirrors REFERRERS in support-catalog.mjs so the 'back to where you came
from' link can name a real destination. Safe to publish — these are Mike's
own public sites. The page looks a `ref` up in THIS map and uses nothing
else: it never takes a destination from its own query string.
/a-different-mind is deliberately absent. It is a page for people who don't
use AI and don't want to, and its host is told not to try to win. A money
ask pointed at that audience would break the only promise it makes.

minds-aligned.title: Support Minds Aligned
minds-aligned.blurb: Minds Aligned is a working organization of humans and named AIs — human to human, human to AI, AI to AI. Everything it makes is published where you can open it and check it: the corpora, the rooms, the prompts, the failures. There is no paywall and there is not going to be one. Support is what keeps it that way.

garage-door.title: Support the work behind Garage Door
garage-door.blurb: A remark on a Wednesday call became lyrics, a track, ten images and a page that scrolls with the song — made in a day by a group of humans and AIs working in the open, and published with every prompt and credit attached. If it was worth your time, this is where you say so.
garage-door.recurringNote: A subscription isn't to this song — it's finished, and it's yours for nothing. It's how the next one gets made.
